_doc: M-subs-desktop: the ONE launch credential rule, shared verbatim by the FE Run gate (engines.ts missingProvidersForModels, vitest) and the server preflight (control_plane/credential_gate.py, pytest). A node's provider is covered by a BYOK key, or — on a Desktop (local) launch only — by a FRESH connected subscription (mirror connected AND the user's Desktop runner polled recently) that Tvashtr Desktop can run (claude, grok). Codex subscriptions cannot run nodes yet. Hosted launches always need a key.

cases.name: hosted launch: a connected subscription never replaces a key
desktop launch: fresh Claude subscription covers anthropic
desktop launch: stale (not fresh) Claude subscription does not cover
desktop launch: Claude + Grok cover a mixed team
desktop launch: the grok/ slug is covered by the Grok subscription too
desktop launch: a Codex subscription cannot run nodes (no runner) — openai still needs a key
a BYOK key covers on either target; uncovered providers are reported sorted
